lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in vertical columns along the lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the centers of the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like nodal structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features on the upper flank displaying a distinct vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and low intensity on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of multiple small, high-contrast yellow and black striped objects (biotic) positioned on the ventral-lateral surface of the primary pectoral fin.
